# v1.21.0 — Grid current sensors and dashboard ordering

- Add Grid Current Phase A, B and C sensors in amps, with 0.1 A resolution.
  These expose registers 0x0017–0x0019 already covered by the normal grid block
  reads. The readings are current magnitudes without import/export direction.
  Thanks to Akashironld for the proposal and SMILE-G3-T10 hardware checks (#3).
- Update the default Main dashboard order. On phones it begins with the flow
  and four summary readings, Force charging, Force discharging and Dispatch.
  Wider screens use a two-column arrangement. All existing cards,
  control actions, Readings and Diagnostics are preserved.
- Refresh GitHub and HACS README previews with light-theme daytime example data.

The sensor addition does not change inverter-control code or the polling
schedule. Existing charging, discharging, export and dispatch controls are
unchanged. The new sensors do not automatically take part in any automation.

## Updating

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the frontend. The three
new sensors are enabled by default unless the integration setting disables new
entities. The generated dashboard is refreshed where still integration-managed;
customised and unrelated dashboards remain untouched.

To roll back, select v1.20.2 in HACS and restart Home Assistant. Any automation
subsequently created using the new sensors will need those sensors retained
or its references adjusted.

## Validation

153 Python tests pass on Home Assistant 2026.10.4/Python 3.14 and
2024.12.5/Python 3.12; 23 frontend tests pass. The new tests exercise decoding,
entity creation, missing data and three minutes of simulated coordinator
polling in Fast, Normal and Slow modes, with unchanged requests and existing
readings and no writes. Packaging tests verify the HACS ZIP layout and contents.

Hardware current accuracy and magnitude behaviour are supported by the issue
reporter's tests; these automated tests do not constitute live inverter
validation. README images use example data.
